title: Go Wrong & Go Well
situation: A machine problem during a shift.
objective: Use go wrong and go well to talk about problems and results.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: At work, not everything goes well all the time.
dialogue.indonesian: Di tempat kerja, tidak semuanya selalu berjalan lancar.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Sometimes something goes wrong with the machine.
dialogue.indonesian: Terkadang ada sesuatu yang bermasalah pada mesin.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When that happens, I need to check the problem and find a solution.
dialogue.indonesian: Ketika itu terjadi, saya perlu memeriksa masalah dan mencari solusi.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I don't want to make a quick decision without checking the machine first.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya tidak ingin mengambil keputusan terburu-buru tanpa memeriksa mesin terlebih dahulu.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I hope everything goes well after the repair.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya berharap semuanya berjalan lancar setelah perbaikan.

learningNotes: go wrong berarti ada masalah atau tidak berjalan sesuai rencana.
not everything goes well all the time berarti tidak semuanya selalu berjalan lancar.
